Belle Meade Highlands West Nashville · 37205

The strongest fit for your checklist: the shortest commute to the hospital (about 16 minutes), Percy Warner Park's trail network literally up the street, and a community pool and clubhouse. The 37205 zip also puts you near Belle Meade and Green Hills shopping.

Tucked away in a quiet residential neighborhood, this spacious 3-bedroom, 2-bath condo offers exceptional privacy and serene, tree-lined views. Thoughtfully updated, the home features stainless steel appliances, crisp white cabinetry, a subway tile backsplash, and butcher block countertops—blending modern style with everyday comfort. Generously sized bedrooms provide more living space than most condos, while abundant storage sets this home apart. Enjoy a walk-in storage room that can double as a home office, a walk-in closet, and an additional exterior storage unit. Both bathrooms have been updated, fresh paint throughout, and the washer and dryer remain. Ideally located near Belle Meade and just minutes from downtown Nashville, this condo also offers easy access to the 2,683 acres of Percy Warner and Edwin Warner Parks. Community amenities include a clubhouse and pool, all surrounded by natural beauty—making this a rare combination of convenience and space.

Priest Lake Park Southeast Nashville · 37217

The most affordable group, right beside Percy Priest Lake — the Anderson Road recreation area (swim beach, trails, campground) is a half-mile away. HOA covers exterior maintenance including the roof, plus water, sewer, and trash, with a pool and tennis courts. The trade-off: the longest commute, about 22–25 minutes.

Welcome to 3880 Priest Lake Dr Unit 54! This beautifully refreshed 3 bedroom, 2.5 bathroom, 1,728 sq ft home is packed with upgrades and ready for you to call it home. Inside, you’ll notice new designer lighting throughout, new luxury vinyl plank flooring downstairs, and plush new carpet upstairs for a clean, updated feel.
